positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Joined the Outlook Android engineering team
- Delivered Microsoft To Do integration in Outlook Android, helping create a more unified productivity experience by bringing task management directly into Outlook Mobile
- Led the design and delivery of Quiet Time. Quiet Time allowed users to configure times where they would not receive notifications from the Outlook and Microsoft Teams apps; it also allowed for IT admin enforced notification policies. This involved working across multiple teams/layers of the stack, covering everything from UX to API definitions/telemetry. I drove alignment across multiple partner teams to deliver the first synchronized settings experience across Microsoft 365 apps
- Shipped QR code sign-in for Outlook Android in partnership with the Microsoft Authenticator and Lens SDK teams, reducing friction during sign-in
- Defined and built the mobile experience for Hybrid Work Hours & Location, partnering closely with product and design teams to establish how flexible work schedules and location visibility would be represented across Outlook Mobile while supporting enterprise administrative controls
- Helped define and launch Sender Screening for Outlook.com consumers. Sender Screening helps combat spam by allowing users to first screen email from non-trusted senders before it lands in their inbox
- Mentored junior engineers, providing technical guidance, design feedback, and career coaching while supporting their day-to-day development and long-term growth

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Moved to work full-time on the GroupMe Android client
- Successfully shipped three of the app’s biggest features to date; “polls”, “dark mode” and admin tools, increasing the Google Play Store rating to 4.5
- Developed full accessibility features for the Android client
- Given full ownership of user experience (UX) for GroupMe product in November 2017

positions.title: Solutions Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed performance tests (using shell scripts) to test performance of backup products in production, and reported results to management
- Built multiple test environments using hardware servers and virtual machines
- Managed recruitment process of replacement interns for the following year
- Had contract extended for excellent performance

projects.title: Nebulus
projects.description:
Nebulus is the must-have SoundCloud client app for Windows Phone that I created.

Built from the ground up, featuring a beautiful redesign and innovative take on the signature waveform control, Nebulus is the best way to experience all the SoundCloud music you love on your Windows Phone.
